name: QuickUI-Agent
description: 💻 Hackable UI Generator with LLMs. Build quick MVP UIs with HTML, Tailwind, Font Awesome, Placehold.co and Groq for superfast generation⚡

paragraphs: Quick UI is a superfast web application UI generator that uses LLMs to quickly generate your UI ideas into polished, ready-to-deploy single-page applications. Utilizing HTML, Tailwind CSS, Bootstrap, Font Awesome, and Google Fonts, the Quick UI Generator streamlines the design process, making it faster to test your idea. Designed for both novices and seasoned developers, this tool simplifies the UI generation process with an intuitive interface and real-time preview capabilities.
